| 所有者问题 (a)：为什么设置了 tint 的 Tab 仍显示默认标题颜色？统一的 tint 入口是否缺了什么？设计上的优先级是什么？ | Owner question (a): why does a tab with a tint still show a default title colour? Is the unified tint entry missing something? What are the design priorities? |
| 所有者问题 (b)：担心 Rive。我们能识别单色与多色的 Lottie，但不能识别 Rive，所以 `automatic` 保留 Rive 的颜色。如何在 TabBar 中给它着色？示例能否覆盖 `automatic`？需要明确哪些设置覆盖默认值。 | Owner question (b): a worry about Rive. Define which settings override the default. |

## [CN]实测结果
## [EN]Findings

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 环境：模拟器 iOS 27.2，iPhone 18 Pro。 | Measured on the simulator: iOS 27.2, iPhone 18 Pro. |
| Gallery 扁平栏：选中图标 `#0088FF`（深色 `#0091FF`），选中标题却是黄色 `#FFCC00` / `#FFD600`。 | Gallery flat bar: the selected icon is `#0088FF` (dark `#0091FF`), but the selected title is yellow, `#FFCC00` / `#FFD600`. |
| ObjC Example 与 Example-Swift-SwiftManager-FlatDesign：浅色与深色下选中图标都保持 Lottie 自身的 `#53D76A`，标题则跟随绿 / 黑 / 白。多色 Lottie 在 `automatic` 下保留原色，这是设计行为。 | ObjC Example and Example-Swift-SwiftManager-FlatDesign: the selected icon stays the Lottie's own `#53D76A` in light and dark, while the titles follow green / black / white. A multi-colour Lottie keeps its colours under `automatic`, by design. |
| Example-Rive（各 Tab 要求 `tint=title`）：Liquid Glass 给选中图标着色；扁平样式让它保持白色（浅色下几乎看不见），并忽略固定色 tint。这是 bug。 | Example-Rive (its tabs ask for `tint=title`): Liquid Glass tints the selected icon; the flat bar leaves it white (nearly invisible in light) and ignores a fixed tint. This is a bug. |
| Tint 页面（独立条目，双色的 `menu_button.riv`）：不透明的强制 tint 把它变成实心圆盘，图形丢失。 | Tint page (standalone items, the two-colour `menu_button.riv`): an opaque forced tint turns it into a solid disc and loses the glyph. |

## [CN]根因
## [EN]Root causes

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 说明：以下来自读代码（行号对应 `9d2b9e7b`），与实测结果吻合，但没有在运行时跟踪。文件：`CYLTabBarController+CYLFlatDesign.swift`、`CYLFlatDesignTabBarButton.swift`（均在 `CYLTabBarController/CYLFlatDesignTabBar/CYLFlatDesignTabBar-ObjectiveC/Swift/`）。 | Note: the following comes from reading the code (line numbers at `9d2b9e7b`); it matches the runs but was not traced at runtime. Files: `CYLTabBarController+CYLFlatDesign.swift` and `CYLFlatDesignTabBarButton.swift` (both in `CYLTabBarController/CYLFlatDesignTabBar/CYLFlatDesignTabBar-ObjectiveC/Swift/`). |
| (1) `CYLTabBarController+CYLFlatDesign.swift:902` 无条件把 `systemYellow` 写入 item 的选中标题颜色，即“App 显式设置”的位置，因此它压过了栏的 `tintColor`。历史：这一行并非起源于 `ed112701`（Swift 迁移第 78 步），该提交把它从 Objective-C 的 `CYLTabBarController.m` 移植过来；已检查：Objective-C 版本的这个标题颜色在 `efd0b90e`（2026-07-08，iOS27 support）中加入；其父提交里 `systemYellowColor` 只出现在 `UIColor` 扩展中，`git log -S` 列出的其他较早提交只涉及该扩展或星星烟花粒子。在 `docs/*.md` 与 `README*` 中按黄色及标题 / 扁平相关词搜索，没有发现任何文档把黄色列为扁平样式的选中标题默认值（唯一命中是烟花粒子）。 | (1) `CYLTabBarController+CYLFlatDesign.swift:902` unconditionally writes `systemYellow` into the item's selected title colour, the slot for what the app sets explicitly, so it beats the bar's `tintColor`. History: the line did not originate in `ed112701` (Swift port step 78); that commit ported it from the Objective-C `CYLTabBarController.m`. Checked: the Objective-C version of this title colour was added in `efd0b90e` (2026-07-08, iOS27 support); in its parent, `systemYellowColor` appears only in the `UIColor` extension, and the other earlier commits listed by `git log -S` touch only that extension or the star-fireworks particles. A search of `docs/*.md` and `README*` for yellow together with title or flat terms found no document naming yellow as the flat selected-title default (the only hit is the fireworks particles). |
| 标题链（`titleTextAttributesForCurrentState`，`CYLFlatDesignTabBarButton.swift` 第 403 行起）：item 属性，appearance 属性（覆盖 item），否则选中为 `tintColor`、未选中为灰色。图标链（第 200–205 行）：`appearance.iconColor`，否则选中为 `tintColor`、未选中为灰色。 | Title chain (`titleTextAttributesForCurrentState`, from line 403 of `CYLFlatDesignTabBarButton.swift`): item attributes, then appearance attributes (which override the item's), else `tintColor` when selected and gray otherwise. Icon chain (lines 200–205): `appearance.iconColor`, else `tintColor` when selected and gray otherwise. |
| (2) 扁平按钮把动画 URL 放在私有的 `tabBarAnimationURL`（第 515 行起），从不设置继承来的 `animationURL`，因此 URL 中的 tint 选项丢失；保存的 Tab 流程渲染模式停留在 `alwaysOriginal`，Rive 视图被告知“不着色”。见 `CYLRiveTabBarItemAnimationView.swift` 第 264–281 行，以及 `CYLTabBarItemAnimationTint.m` 第 148–180 行与第 395–411 行。 | (2) The flat button keeps the animation URL in a private `tabBarAnimationURL` (from line 515) and never sets the inherited `animationURL`, so the URL tint options are lost; the stored tab-flow rendering mode stays `alwaysOriginal` and the Rive view is told "no tint". See `CYLRiveTabBarItemAnimationView.swift` lines 264–281, and `CYLTabBarItemAnimationTint.m` lines 148–180 and 395–411. |

## [CN]顾问建议
## [EN]Advisor recommendations

### [CN]问题 1：扁平样式的标题与图标颜色
### [EN]Issue 1: flat title and icon colours

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 现在就作为核心修复来做。 | Do it now, as a core fix. |
| 扁平按钮中用一个解析器同时处理标题和图标，层级从高到低：(1) App 按 Tab 设置：item 标题前景色（仅标题）；动画则为 `animationTint` 或 URL tint。(2) 栏 appearance 按状态的 `titleTextAttributes` / `iconColor`。(3) 栏颜色：选中时为 `tintColor`（若已有普通状态的颜色 API 也一并使用）。(4) 标题与图标共用的库默认值（选中为默认 tint，普通为 `systemGray`）。 | Use one resolver in the flat button for both title and icon, with tiers from high to low: (1) set by the app per tab: the item title foreground colour (title only); for animations, `animationTint` or a URL tint. (2) The bar appearance's `titleTextAttributes` / `iconColor` per state. (3) Bar colours: `tintColor` when selected (plus an existing normal-state colour API, if any). (4) A library default shared by title and icon (selected: the default tint; normal: `systemGray`). |
| 把图标结果传给 `applyIconTintColor`。 | Feed the icon result to `applyIconTintColor`. |
| 删除第 902 行之前先查历史。如果黄色是写进文档的默认值，就把它移到第 4 层并同时用于标题和图标，绝不放在第 1 层。 | Check the history before removing line 902. If yellow was a documented default, move it to tier 4 for both title and icon, never to tier 1. |
| 可见变化：从未设置选中标题颜色的扁平样式 App，颜色从黄色变为自己的 tint（默认蓝色）。 | Visible change: flat apps that never set a selected title colour go from yellow to their tint (blue by default). |
| 为解析器编写测试。 | Add resolver tests. |

### [CN]问题 2：动画着色
### [EN]Issue 2: animation tinting

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 可选开启的覆盖方式已经存在，不改默认值。 | The opt-in override already exists; do not change the default. |
| (1) 按 Tab 显式设置的 tint（`animationTint`，或 URL 的 `tint=#RRGGBB` / `tint=title`）对所有引擎（包括 Rive）总是着色。(2) 按 Tab 的 `renderingMode=alwaysTemplate` 用解析出的图标颜色着色，`alwaysOriginal` 从不着色。(3) 默认的 `automatic` 只给检测为单色的文件（Lottie JSON、GIF）着色；Rive、PAG、SVGA 保留原色。 | (1) An explicit per-tab tint (`animationTint`, or the URL's `tint=#RRGGBB` / `tint=title`) always tints every engine, Rive included. (2) A per-tab `renderingMode=alwaysTemplate` tints with the resolved icon colour; `alwaysOriginal` never tints. (3) The default, `automatic`, tints only files detected as one-colour (Lottie JSON, GIF); Rive, PAG and SVGA keep their colours. |
| 需核实 iOS Tab 路径上哪种选项形式有效：ClassifyMenu 会话报告 URL query 被忽略、`animationOptions` 有效；`CYLTabBarAnimationURLWithOptions` 写入的是 URL fragment。 | Check which option form works on the iOS tab path: the ClassifyMenu session reported that the URL query was ignored and that `animationOptions` works; `CYLTabBarAnimationURLWithOptions` writes the fragment. |
| 文档中说明：不透明的 tint 会把多色图形变成剪影。 | Document that an opaque tint turns multi-colour art into a silhouette. |
| 示例中开启：Example-Rive（已是 `tint=title`）与 SwiftManager-FlatDesign（SwiftManager 的开启已于 2026-11-27 按所有者要求回退，使用默认 `automatic`）；ObjC 示例的绿色 Lottie 保留，作为 `automatic` 的参照。 | Opt-ins for Example-Rive (already `tint=title`) and SwiftManager-FlatDesign (the SwiftManager opt-in was reverted on 2026-11-27 by the owner: it runs on the default `automatic`); keep the ObjC example's green Lottie as the reference for `automatic`. |
